goal: Fix immediate connection failures in bitcoin-cli when running with no RPC timeout on macOS and BSD
Ensure socket waiting logic accepts large timeout durations without failing system calls
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Support for capping the wait timeout as simple and effective (winterrdog)
Verified by building and running tests on Windows (winterrdog)
Suggested scoping down the change to keep the backport simple (maflcko)

categories.name: build
why: P2 because it fixes a platform-specific runtime regression on macOS and BSD
where running bitcoin-cli with zero timeout failed immediately

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because it resolves a regression breaking zero-timeout CLI calls
restoring expected RPC client connectivity when timeouts are disabled

categories.name: utils
why: P2 because it prevents utility socket wait operations from failing or overflowing
when callers pass extremely large timeout durations
